topic: Disputing a wrong charge vs ignoring it (Tom vs Rita)

scenes.narration: Federal law gives you sixty days to dispute a wrong charge. After that the money is gone. I am Judge Vera and today two cardholders made very different choices. Court is in session!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera at the courtroom bench pointing her gavel at a wall calendar with sixty days circled in red, comic burst banner reads SIXTY DAYS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Tom and Rita each open their statements and find the same mystery charge from a gym they never joined, four hundred dollars each.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, two adults tom and rita at separate kitchen tables holding paper statements with a red highlighted line reading FOUR HUNDRED MYSTERY GYM, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Tom assumes the charge will fall off on its own, tosses the statement on the counter, and forgets about it for three months.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man tom shrugging and tossing a paper statement onto a messy kitchen counter, dust building on a stack of unopened envelopes, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Rita calls her bank that same afternoon, files a written dispute, and sends the bank a copy of her membership records to prove she never signed up.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman rita on the phone at a kitchen table with a notebook, a big written letter labeled WRITTEN DISPUTE in front of her, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Sixty days later Tom calls the bank to fight the charge but the dispute window is closed and he is now legally responsible for the four hundred dollars.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, shocked man tom on the phone with a bank rep, a giant red comic banner reading TOO LATE blocks the screen behind him, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Rita got her four hundred dollars credited back in ten days and the bank closed the merchant account for fraud.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split scene, left side tom looking at a bill labeled FOUR HUNDRED OWED, right side rita celebrating a credit notice labeled REFUNDED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Open every statement the day it arrives and dispute anything you do not recognize in writing. Sixty days is your only window. Court dismissed!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera banging her gavel, holding up a checklist labeled FILE WRITTEN DISPUTE, comic banner reads SIXTY DAY RULE, kids comic book illustration
